name: (03) Immanence of Set — 2 Intermediate — Lord of Storms

system.description:
Long before his incarnation as tempter, Set was the god of darkness and storm. This power lets the Setite summon a raging sandstorm (or thunderstorm) that blocks out the sky and drives sane creatures to shelter, while the Setite and his retinue move through it untouched.

The player spends three Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait, summoning a storm blanketing a square mile around the caster; additional Willpower Traits extend the radius by 10 miles each. The Setite and anyone in his immediate retinue travel through the storm as though it were calm, clear weather. The storm lasts at least one scene, longer at the Storyteller's discretion. This power has often been used to cover a Setite's escape or hinder pursuers.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three
system.prerequisites: Setite Sorcery (Immanence of Set); a Follower of Set in good standing with his temple
